description: we are Year 9 student with interests that span science, space, creative writing, design.
summary:
Project format: Educational explainer video

Target audience: Children and young learners

Purpose: To introduce children to robotic space exploration, explain how robots help scientists explore distant environments, and make complex scientific discoveries easier to understand.

Presentation style: A short, engaging, visually driven explainer featuring narration, images, illustrations and accessible scientific explanations.
